digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate CLI and retry mechanism
propositions: Add CLI flag `--retry` to resume only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review with a fresh attempt budget, reusing successful/resumed units and re-running failed/cancelled/shed units from the discovery journal.

Retry eligibility requires latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar with versioned discovery_journal enumerating units by outcome kind (success/resumed/failed/cancelled); refuse before any model call if result is non-INDETERMINATE, missing journal, stale (identity-digest mismatch), corrupt, or legacy.

Recompute checkpoint_identity digest for each reusable unit from current ticket material, code/ref, policy, prompts, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and source; reuse findings only if envelope loads via sizing.load_checkpoint; treat missing/mismatched envelopes as missing and re-run.

Pass-2 verification/coaching, deterministic decision/assembly, and signature eligibility rerun over combined reused and newly recovered results; cumulative lineage spend is audit-telemetry only and never blocks later explicit retry.
`--retry` mutually excludes `--force`, `--status`, `--check`; remains compatible with `--no-sign`; exits with code 2 on ineligible/refused retry and prints full-review remedy to stderr.

Document flag in canonical `review-plan --help`, generated CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes guide with eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal, flag interactions, signing behavior, and normal-review fallback.
